ai.addressAboutText: The address is https, or http://localhost when the person who runs this server allows it. It is used exactly as typed.
ai.addressHint: An OpenAI compatible server, usually ending in /v1, with no name, password or key in the address.
ai.addressV1: Most servers expect the address to end in /v1, for example http://localhost:1234/v1.
ai.adminsOnly: Only owners and admins can change these settings.
ai.budgetHint: What this workspace may use per month (UTC), counted in tokens. 0 means no limit here.
ai.budgetWarn: This is an estimate: set a spending limit with your provider too.
ai.costHint: Add both prices per million tokens for an estimate, and a monthly cap in dollars that stops runs before it passes.
ai.costWarn: The estimate is not your bill: check it with your provider.
ai.description: Suggestions for keywords, listing text and review replies. You accept each one yourself; nothing goes to a store.
ai.enableHint: While this is off, nothing leaves this server for an AI provider.
ai.enableLabel: Turn on AI assistance for this workspace
ai.keyHint: Kept in the credential vault and never shown again; leave it empty to keep what is saved.
ai.keySaved: A key is saved. Type a new one to replace it.
ai.loadFailed: Could not load the AI settings.
ai.localModel: This model runs on your own machine or network, so nothing is billed and no limit or price is needed.
ai.modelHint: Pick from the list or type the name as your provider gives it; the model must return structured answers.
ai.modelPlaceholder: pick one or type the name
ai.modelsCountNotListed_one: {{count}} model available. The name you typed is not in the list; it is kept as typed.
ai.modelsCountNotListed_other: {{count}} models available. The name you typed is not in the list; it is kept as typed.
ai.modelsLoadFailed: Could not load the list of models. You can still type the name.
ai.needsText: Off by default. It needs the server switch (KILN_AI_ENABLED) and the setting below, a provider, a model and, for most providers, a key.
ai.pricesAboutText: Take the prices from your provider's price list. 0 or empty means not set. The cap needs both prices. A model on your own machine costs nothing here: leave them empty.
ai.sentSummary: What is sent, task by task
ai.softHint: From this share of the limit on, a run says how much is used; runs keep working until 100%. 0 is off.
ai.softLabel: Warn me at (percent of a limit)
ai.testFailed: The test did not work. Try again.
ai.testNeedsReady: The test needs AI to be on and set up (see the status above).
ai.testNote: The test sends one fixed small request with no data of yours.
ai.testSaveFirst: Save first: the test uses the saved settings.
ai.title: AI assistant
ai.usageMeter: Share of the monthly limit used
analytics.aboutSummary: About the bucket and the sync
analytics.aboutText: The service account needs read access to the bucket. It is the default for every Android app; an app of another Play account sets its own under App settings. How often it syncs is set by the server (KILN_ANALYTICS_INTERVAL_MINUTES, every 6 hours by default), not here.
analytics.bucketHint: The bucket of the monthly Play Console reports, like pubsite_prod_rev_01234567890123456789. Sales (estimated, what buyers paid), monthly earnings (net of Google's fees and taxes) and subscription statistics come from the same bucket and also need the Play Console permission View financial data, set to Global.
analytics.description: Daily numbers for your apps from the stores. Off until an owner or an admin turns it on.
analytics.enabledHint: Reads numbers from App Store Connect and Google Play and keeps them on this server. It only reads.
analytics.readsText: Downloads, page views, crashes and sales from App Store Connect, and installs, crash rates, ratings and estimated sales from Google Play. Numbers already stored stay readable when this is off.
analytics.title: Analytics
analytics.vendorHint: 5 to 12 digits, from App Store Connect under Payments and Financial Reports. Empty: no sales numbers (units and proceeds, also by product).
error.noRole: Your role does not include workspace settings.
error.ownerOrAdmin: Only an owner or an admin can change settings.
error.saveFailed: The settings could not be saved. Try again.
form.bucketId: Use a bucket id such as pubsite_prod_rev_01234567890123456789 (or the gs:// address).
form.dailyCharBudget: A whole number from 0 to {{max}} (0 means no limit here).
form.libreNeedsUrl: LibreTranslate needs the address of a server.
form.stalledAfterHours: A whole number of hours from 0 to {{max}} (0 turns the signal off).
form.stalledRepeatHours: A whole number of hours from 0 to {{max}} (0 reminds once).
form.syncInterval: A whole number of minutes from {{min}} to {{max}}.
form.targetLanguage: A language code such as en, de or pt-BR.
form.unansweredReminderHours: A whole number of hours from 0 to {{max}} (0 is off).
form.vendorNumber: A vendor number is 5 to 12 digits.
jump.label: Jump to a section

lastRefresh.never: No scheduled refresh has run yet.
libreUrl.fullAddress: Enter the full address, for example https://translate.example.com.
libreUrl.noCredentials: Leave the user name and password out of the address. Put the API key under Credentials.
libreUrl.noQuery: The address must not have a query string or a fragment.
libreUrl.useHttps: Use https. Plain http is only accepted for a server on the same machine.
mail.description: The mail server that sends confirmation codes and alert emails. Its password is kept encrypted and never shown again.
mail.locked: This server's mail settings come from its environment (KILN_SMTP_*). Change them there and restart the server.
mail.noTls: Without TLS, messages cross the network as plain text. Use this only for a mail server on this machine.
mail.passwordSaved: Saved. Leave empty to keep it.
mail.saveFirst: Save the mail server first; the test message goes to your own address.
mail.title: Mail
mcp.configHelp: Paste one into your assistant. The HTTP address is {{url}}.
mcp.configPlaceholder: The token is a placeholder until you create one.
mcp.createNote: A viewer token for the read tools; a wider one is made under API tokens.
mcp.description: Let an MCP assistant such as Claude or Cursor read this workspace. It can preview store actions, never apply them.
mcp.stdioText: It starts a small local command (apps/server/src/mcp/stdio.ts, Node 22.18 or newer): replace the path with where this repository is on your computer.
mcp.title: Connect an AI assistant
mcp.tokenWarning_one: Shown once. Put it in the assistant's configuration below, not in code. Revoke it under API tokens if it leaks; it expires on its own after {{count}} day.
mcp.tokenWarning_other: Shown once. Put it in the assistant's configuration below, not in code. Revoke it under API tokens if it leaks; it expires on its own after {{count}} days.
mode.auto.help: New reviews in another language are translated after each sync (at most 20 per sync, within the daily budget). Failures never fail the sync.
mode.auto.label: Automatic
mode.off.help: Nothing is translated, even if translation is enabled.
mode.off.label: Off
mode.onDemand.help: Someone clicks Translate on a review. Only that review is sent.
mode.onDemand.label: On demand
nav.label: Settings sections
nav.unsavedWithLink: You have unsaved workspace changes. They stay until you save or discard them there. <link>Go to the workspace settings</link>.
page.description: Choices for the whole workspace: store refresh, reminders, translation, security and AI.
page.noRole: Your role does not include workspace settings. Members, admins and owners can see them.
page.otherSectionAnalytics: A value in Analytics is not valid. Fix it there, then save.
page.otherSectionWorkspace: A value in another workspace section is not valid. Fix it there, then save.
page.title: Settings
provider.privacy.azure: Review text is sent to Microsoft Azure. Check Microsoft’s terms for your resource before you turn this on.
provider.privacy.deepl: Review text is sent to DeepL. Check DeepL’s terms for your plan (Free or Pro) before you turn this on.
provider.privacy.google: Review text is sent to Google Cloud. Check Google’s terms for your account before you turn this on.
provider.privacy.libretranslate: Review text is sent to the LibreTranslate server whose address you enter. On your own server it stays with you; on a hosted one it goes to that operator.
releases.afterHint: A started release with no progress, such as an unchosen build or an approved version nobody released, is shown as “Release left unfinished”. 0 turns the reminder off.
releases.afterLabel: Remind me when a release stands still for (hours)
releases.description: When a release counts as left unfinished.
releases.title: Releases
reviews.maxRatingHint: Used by the reminder, the unanswered badge and the “Show unanswered” list.
reviews.maxRatingLabel: Count unanswered reviews rated at or below
reviews.reminderHint: One reminder at most this often. 0 is off (the default).
reviews.reminderLabel: Remind me about unanswered reviews after (hours)
reviews.thresholdHint: Reviews at or below this are marked Low rating and raise an alert. A change applies from the next sync, and not to reviews already read.
reviews.title: Reviews
security.accountPasswordConfirms: Your account password confirms. Change it with your account.
security.codesNeedFactor: Add a passkey or a confirmation password first. Recovery codes stand in for them.
security.description: Ask for a passkey or password again before anything that cannot be undone: publishing, releasing, changing a rollout, deleting a credential.
security.lostHelp: Lost your passkey or password? Remove the lost passkey or set a new confirmation password in the card above. When you are asked to confirm, choose “Use a recovery code”. Using a code is recorded in the audit log.
security.noPasskeysBody: Passkeys need a browser that offers them and an address that is https or http://localhost. The desktop app's window may not offer them. Use a password instead, or open this server in a browser.
security.noPasskeysBodyBelow: Passkeys need a browser that offers them and an address that is https or http://localhost. The desktop app's window may not offer them. Use a password instead (below), or open this server in a browser.
security.noPasskeysTitle: Passkeys are not available in this window
security.noWayToConfirm: You have no way to confirm yet. Add a passkey or set a confirmation password first, or hard actions will be refused for you.
security.passkeyNameNeeded: Give the passkey a name, such as “MacBook Touch ID”.
security.passkeyNote: Your device asks for Touch ID, Face ID, Windows Hello or your PIN. Only a public key is stored here.
security.passwordNone: This app has no sign-in password, so set one here to confirm with.
security.passwordRules: At least 12 characters. It is stored hashed, wrong guesses lock confirmation for a while, and it only confirms actions; it does not sign anyone in.
security.policyOff: Not switched on. An owner or admin can switch it on.
security.policyOn: Switched on by an owner or admin for: {{actions}}.
security.policyToggle: Ask for a confirmation before hard actions (recommended)
security.recoveryDescription: Ten one-time codes to confirm with when your passkey or password is lost. Keep them offline.
security.replaceWarn_one: Making new codes stops every old one from working, including the {{count}} you have left. You will be asked to confirm.
security.replaceWarn_other: Making new codes stops every old one from working, including the {{count}} you have left. You will be asked to confirm.
security.saveCodesBody: They are shown only this once and cannot be looked up again. Keep them in a password manager or print them. Each works once.
security.title: Security: confirm hard actions
security.unattendedSummary: Allow API tokens without a person (CI and automation)
security.unattendedText: A token cannot confirm anything, so by default a token that does a covered action is refused. Tick an action to let tokens do it with no confirmation at all. That is the trade-off for automation: anyone who holds such a token can do it.
sync.description: Reads your apps from the stores on a schedule, so alerts can tell you what changed.
sync.enabledHint: On by default. It only reads the stores; nothing is changed there. It is what lets alerts tell you when a release is approved, rejected or halted.
sync.enabledLabel: Refresh my apps from the stores on a schedule
sync.everyHint: A shorter time notices a change sooner and asks the stores more often.
sync.howText: Each app is read again when this long has passed since its last read, spread out a little so the reads do not all start together. Google Play reports no review state, so for Android apps alerts cover what Play does report: the track, the rollout, and a halted rollout.
sync.title: Store refresh
syncOff.server: Scheduled refresh is turned off for the whole server (KILN_SYNC_INTERVAL_MINUTES is 0), so the settings below have no effect until the person who runs the server changes it.
syncOff.workspace: Scheduled refresh is off for this workspace. Alerts only change when someone syncs an app by hand.
test.ok: The provider translated a test word. Saved settings and key work.
translation.adminCanAdd: An admin can add it under Credentials.
translation.budgetHint: The most this workspace sends per day (UTC). 0 means no limit here.
translation.credentialInUse: A credential of this kind is in use.
translation.description: Translate customer reviews with a service you choose.
translation.enableHint: While this is off, no review text leaves this server.
translation.keysInVault: Keys are kept in the vault and are never shown here.
translation.libreHint: Starts with https://, with no user name, password or key in it.
translation.libreKeyOptional: Add a key only if your LibreTranslate server asks for one.
translation.privateSummary: About a server on a private network
translation.privateText: A server on a private network needs KILN_TRANSLATE_ALLOW_PRIVATE_URLS=true on this server.
translation.readOnly: Only owners and admins can change these settings. You can see what is set.
translation.saveToSee: Save to see the credential of {{provider}}.
translation.targetHint: A language code such as en, de or pt-BR. Reviews already in it are not sent.
translation.testNote: Translates one fixed word, not review text, and uses no budget.
translation.testSaveFirst: Save first: the test uses the saved settings.
translation.title: Translation
twoFactor.codeSent: A code was sent to {{to}}. It works once and lasts 10 minutes.
twoFactor.description: Two more ways to confirm a hard action: the six digits of an authenticator app, or a code sent to your email.
twoFactor.emailEnter: Enter the address to send codes to; a code is sent there to prove it is yours.
twoFactor.emailSignInAddress: A code is sent to the email address you sign in with, to prove it is yours.
twoFactor.emailUnusable: This address no longer matches your account email, so it is not used. Remove it and verify again.
twoFactor.loginLegend: After the password, ask for a second factor:
twoFactor.membersNote_one: {{count}} member has no second factor yet. Anyone it applies to sets one up at their next sign-in; until they do, only the password protects that account.
twoFactor.membersNote_other: {{count}} members have no second factor yet. Anyone it applies to sets one up at their next sign-in; until they do, only the password protects that account.
twoFactor.membersToast_one: {{count}} member has no second factor yet and will set one up at their next sign-in.
twoFactor.membersToast_other: {{count}} members have no second factor yet and will set one up at their next sign-in.
twoFactor.noMailAdmin: Codes cannot be emailed until a mail server is added (the Mail card below).
twoFactor.noMailMember: Codes cannot be emailed until a mail server is added by an owner or admin.
twoFactor.noMailTitle: No mail server is set up
twoFactor.title: Authenticator app and email
twoFactor.totpActive: On. Codes change every 30 seconds and work once.
twoFactor.totpActiveSince: On since {{date}}. Codes change every 30 seconds and work once.
twoFactor.totpNotSetUp: Not set up. Works with 1Password, Authy, Google Authenticator, Microsoft Authenticator, Apple Passwords and any app that follows the TOTP standard.
usage.unlimited_one: {{count}} character used today (UTC). There is no daily limit here.
usage.unlimited_other: {{count}} characters used today (UTC). There is no daily limit here.
